summary: DFM method files now store the input triangle without its redundant mask and without trailing null padding, so the saved JSON is easier to read.
details: A cell is inside the triangle if and only if it holds a value, so the mask is derived on load instead of stored.
Each input row now ends at its last populated development period, matching how ratio values and excluded cells are already stored.
Nulls inside a row still mark values missing inside the triangle.
Method revisions, calculations, and API payloads are unchanged, and files written before this change still load.
